market_context_summary: U.S. equities were near records while oil rose on Strait of Hormuz uncertainty; weak July payrolls lowered near-term rate-hike pressure, but Wednesday CPI remained the week's main macro risk.

methodology.disparity_formula: 70% of half the direction-score range plus 30% of the reversal-risk range, rounded to 0-100

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Pharma & Specialty segment profit and FY2027 guide
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: A merely in-line FY2027 outlook after a strong run
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Specialty-led profit momentum and repeated guidance raises favor another constructive reaction if the FY2027 outlook clears a high bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $2.42; the market expects continued specialty strength after FY2026 EPS guidance rose to $10.70-$10.80.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Specialty profit, cash flow, and FY2027 EPS outlook beat elevated expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Valuation and a long beat streak leave little room for a conservative initial FY2027 guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Liquid options; exact live implied move was not reliably available publicly.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent official guidance was raised and narrowed; external coverage remained constructive.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Shopee GMV growth with EBITDA discipline
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong Shopee GMV momentum, improving ecosystem monetization, and profitable Monee/Garena support upside if investment does not dilute EBITDA quality.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management targets roughly 25% 2026 Shopee GMV growth with full-year adjusted EBITDA no lower than 2025.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: GMV and take-rate strength arrive with better-than-feared Shopee EBITDA and stable Monee credit quality.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Marketing and logistics investment outruns monetization or loan growth weakens asset quality.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options are active; exact live implied move was unavailable from a dependable open source.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published preview evidence was mixed, but Q1 operating momentum exceeded the broad narrative bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Brand momentum and a 64.2% Q1 gross margin support upside, but the setup needs strong sales and a raised outlook rather than a routine beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus was roughly $0.38 EPS and $1.13 billion revenue after three straight EPS beats.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Direct-to-consumer growth and tariff resilience produce another margin beat and outlook raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: North America demand or tariff costs weaken the second-half margin guide.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: High pre-earnings options interest was reported; exact implied move was not verified.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 profitability guidance was raised; the bar has moved higher with the stock.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Low bar plus cash-flow beat sparks relief
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Negative ARR and revenue growth keep the base case bearish unless managed security traction or guidance materially improves the forward growth path.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 guide called for about $820 million ARR, $207-$209 million revenue, and $0.33-$0.36 non-GAAP EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: ARR stabilizes earlier than expected while margins and free cash flow beat.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: ARR deterioration persists and the full-year revenue or cash-flow outlook is cut.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Small-cap cybersecurity positioning can amplify a relief move; live implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus revenue clustered around the company's guide; the growth bar is low.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A rich narrative valuation and July financing put the burden on precise launch and service milestones, though fresh operational proof could reverse the move sharply.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Headline EPS/revenue matter less than the path to 45 satellites and beta service; BlueBird 11-13 launched days before earnings.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Management confirms manufacturing cadence, beta-service timing, and funding sufficiency.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Launch cadence slips, commercial revenue remains distant, or financing credibility worsens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail attention is intense and options are likely pricing a large move; exact straddle was not verified.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sell-side views are mixed; the key bar is operational milestones, not EPS.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Rate/oil shock or soft retailer commentary
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High occupancy, rent growth, and a Q1 FFO guide raise provide a clean, lower-disparity positive setup.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus FFO was near $3.22; Q1 occupancy was 96.0% and base rent rose 5.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: NOI and retailer sales remain firm and 2026 FFO guidance rises again.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Tenant sales slow or higher rates pressure valuation despite a solid quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Lower-beta REIT setup; exact implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The company raised 2026 Real Estate FFO guidance at Q1.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong Q1 comparisons and trading-volume sensitivity create a deceleration risk, but volatile crypto and commodities activity could still drive a sharp beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q1 net contribution rose 19%, adjusted EBITDA 35%, and funded accounts 12%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Trading activity, AUA, and funded accounts remain strong with disciplined acquisition costs.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Net contribution normalizes and marketing spend weakens incremental margins.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Newer public listing with event-sensitive positioning; reliable implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Limited post-IPO estimate history reduces confidence in the published bar.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Subscription monetization and lower revenue-sharing costs favor modest upside if paying-user and ARPPU trends offset social-entertainment weakness.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q1 revenue grew 7%; music-related services grew 12% while social entertainment declined.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Paying users, ARPPU, and music gross margin beat expectations.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Social entertainment weakness or content costs offset subscription gains.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: ADR and China-factor moves can exceed company-specific fundamentals; exact implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public evidence suggests a steady rather than aggressively raised bar.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Flat revenue and leverage dilute backlog quality
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A growing backlog, 1.2x book-to-bill, and strong cash conversion offer upside if management maintains execution and deleveraging credibility.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 backlog was $47.8 billion, up 7%; full-year FCF guidance was $525-$575 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings, margin, and cash flow support a guidance raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Backlog conversion slows and 3.2x leverage remains sticky.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options liquidity is thinner than mega-caps; exact implied move unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Official guidance was reaffirmed, leaving room for an execution-led raise.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Neutron timing and acquisition/capital needs create downside risk, but record backlog and contract momentum make a bearish event call too reversal-prone.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 revenue guide was $225-$240 million; consensus near $232-$236 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Neutron stays on schedule and backlog/space-systems guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Neutron slips into 2027 or integration and funding needs rise.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Heavy retail/options attention implies a large two-sided move; exact straddle not verified.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst targets remained constructive, but buy-side focus appears above headline consensus.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record wins and margin execution are constructive, but calendar effects and a 41x earnings multiple leave limited directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: FY2026 organic growth was guided to the high end of 7%-9%, AOI growth 12%-17%, and EPS growth 20%-25%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: New-business mobilization drives clean margin expansion and a raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Calendar normalization exposes softer underlying organic growth.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Official outlook improved for organic revenue but not the other main guideposts.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Plaquemines ramp and LNG pricing are favorable, but a sharp pre-earnings run, leverage, and legal complexity make the immediate reaction too two-sided.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 EBITDA guide was about $632 million; Phase I COD remained targeted for Q4 2026.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Commissioning volumes and EBITDA guide rise while COD stays intact.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: COD slips, spot margins soften, or legal/capex risk grows.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were up sharply into the print, increasing sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Operating estimates rose with the LNG ramp, but risk discounts remain large.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Subscriber growth and GLP-1 revenue quality
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Regulatory and credibility risks offset strong demand signals, leaving no clean directional edge despite a bearish fundamental tilt.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus revenue was roughly $699-$724 million and EPS around negative $0.04 to $0.05.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Subscriber/card data translates into a clean beat and raised guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: GLP-1 mix, regulatory scrutiny, or lower revenue quality weakens guidance.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Retail-heavy and high-volatility; likely large implied move, not reliably quantified.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analyst views were split between demand upside and regulatory/credibility risk.
